purpose: Define USE/user selection semantics: when an explicit use or user selection is present, only the listed capability/module set participates in the selected boot surface, subject to explicit dependencies and pruning.

topics.name: USE Selection
topics.purpose: Define USE/user selection semantics: when an explicit use or user selection is present, only the listed capability/module set participates in the selected boot surface, subject to explicit dependencies and pruning.

semantics.selection_rule: Presence of explicit use/user selection switches capability selection to the listed set.
semantics.absence_rule: Behavior without use/user selection follows the owning baseline profile contract.
semantics.dependency_rule: Selection does not silently add dependencies.
semantics.pruning_rule: Explicit negative pruning is applied according to profile ordering rules.
semantics.visibility_rule: Resolved selected set is machine-readable before activation.

invariants.rule: Boot selection, pruning, dependency validation and activation are explicit; the runtime never silently enables missing dependencies.

hard_gates.condition: unlisted capability silently enabled under explicit use/user selection
resolved set hidden until after activation

references.purpose: USE selection is additive explicit boot composition.
